title: A Piece of Heaven
meta_description: Welcome to Piece of Heaven by AvantStay! This 4BR home in Blue Mountain Beach sleeps 14 with a private pool, rooftop balcony \& walkable beach access.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Step into your very own "Piece Of Heaven". This lovely beach home, comfortably sleeps 14 guests and is located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach. This beautiful, pet friendly, beach home is located south of 30A in a quiet cul-de-sac with a backyard oasis and private pool! Truly a one-of-a-kind property on 30A featuring 3 bedrooms, 3 balconies and a large rooftop balcony made for kicking back in the sun or taking in the gulf breeze. The home is tastefully furnished and ready to make great beach memories.

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach is a quaint coastal community along 30A between Grayton Beach and Gulf Place. Known for it's laid back vibe yet with all the amenities we look for in a beach vacation. Just steps to the Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access and lots of restaurants like Red Fish Taco, Blue Mable Smokehouse and the Blue Mountain Creamery (best ice cream) nearby. And if you love cinnamon rolls, grab a cup of coffee and a cinnamon roll from Blue Mountain Bakery, you won't regret it. What more could you ask for on your 30a vacation....walking distance to the beach...private pool and ice-cream!

BEACH ACCESS: Just a quick walk from the house to Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access. There are restrooms, shower, some parking and coolers, wagons and single inflatable toys are permitted, as well as kayaks and paddle boards.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- Twin/Full Bunk and Queen Sleeper Sofa, adjoining bath (1st Floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- King Master, ensuite (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 3 -- Family suite -- King bed, twin/full bunk, ensuite (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 4 -- Queen, ensuite (3rd Floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Private backyard pool and lounge area (pool heated up on request)
• Pets Allowed with $250 Fee/ Dog
• Bedroom on main floor
• Covered balcony with outdoor seating
• Mini Kitchenette upstairs
• Self Check-In
• 2 Bicycles
• Washer \& Dryer
• Grill - Propane
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.

Parking Details:
- There is room for up to 3-4 vehicles, depending on their size.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
